subject: need help with geom_map and coord_map

messages.author: 01cd8de9535fc3d1
messages.subject: need help with geom_map and coord_map
parts:
I can't get coord_map to work with geom_map:

This:
crimes <- data.frame(state = tolower(rownames(USArrests)), USArrests)
library(reshape2) # for melt
crimesm <- melt(crimes, id = 1)
if (require(maps)) {
states_map <- map_data("state")
ggplot(crimes, aes(map_id = state)) +
geom_map(aes(fill = Murder), map = states_map) +
expand_limits(x = states_map$long, y = states_map$lat) +
coord_map(project = "polyconic")
}

gives this:
Error in validDetails.polygon(x) :
'x' and 'y' and 'id' must all be same length

The example comes right from ?geom_map except that I added the call to
coord_map.

Anyone know what I'm doing wrong?

David
